newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE may lose steam at 4,990 level.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE may lose steam at 4,990 level.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index is capable of stretching up to 4,990 on Wednesday but may fall short of that and ease to 4,655 before attempting to go higher, technical analysts said.
"Leading share prices have been going in the right direction for market bulls so far this week but problems are looming as the market contemplates the 5,000 level," said one analyst.
"Without further support from Wall Street over the next few days the FTSE will become a little insecure and the inclination may be to settle back a little before making a push for 4,990."
By 0738 GMT, the FTSE was up 11.9 to 4,972.5.

Apart from the near 65-point gallop by the FTSE on Tuesday on relatively high volume -- total market volume reached 945 million compared with Monday's 599 million -- bullish sentiment was also indicated by a gap on a daily bar chart of the index, analysts said.
In an uptrend this occurs when share prices open and stay above the previous day's high.

The FTSE's 10-day moving average and short-term momentum -- which give a measure of the rate of change by the market -- are also moving up and indicate there is scope for the index to go higher and penetration above 5,000 may not be too far away.
